unused_gap: days 15-21 of each month; next month boundaries have no additional purge
primary_selection_metric: average precision; tie break ROC AUC
benchmark: 2023 already examined in previous study; not a fresh independent test
search: matched constrained/unconstrained logistic; spline additive; environmental interactions; softened multiplicative; RF/XGB/LGBM class handling
calibration_rule: choose identity, sigmoid-logit or isotonic using first half of calibration days to fit and remaining calibration days to assess Brier; refit selected mapping on all calibration rows
bootstrap: Full benchmark rows; paired circular moving day blocks of length 7 and 30; 300 replicates each; paired AUC and AP intervals
scope: bounded reproducible search; no assertion of global optimality
independent_test_availability: Included MODIS ends December 2023; no complete later nine-driver dataset available. No independent generalization claim.
